welcome.title: Welcome to Cambodia
welcome.description: Cambodia is a land of contrasts — ancient temples rise from dense jungles, bustling markets sit beside serene rivers, and vibrant cities pulse with energy while rural villages maintain centuries-old traditions. From the world-famous Angkor Wat to the pristine beaches of Koh Rong, Cambodia offers unforgettable experiences at every turn.

history.title: A Brief History
history.description: The Khmer Empire, one of the most powerful empires in Southeast Asia, flourished from the 9th to the 15th century. Its legacy lives on in the magnificent temples of Angkor, the largest religious monument in the world. Today, Cambodia blends its rich heritage with a dynamic, modern spirit.
